findings.highlight: Afterwards, my body started to heal on its own, and was back to normal after a few minutes.
findings.evidenceJa: その後、よく見れば俺の体は勝手に治りはじめ、十分もしたら外見は元通りになった。
findings.governingReading: After about ten minutes his exterior returns to normal.
findings.explanation: The ten-minute recovery interval becomes an unspecific few minutes. (alternate branch).

findings.highlight: "No way. I can't revive someone on the verge of death. What was I supposed to do about your intestines scattered on the pavement?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「まさか。死にかけてる人間を蘇生させる、なんて芸当は、もうわたしには出来ない。衛宮士郎は自分でぶっ飛んだ中身をどうにかしたのよ」
findings.governingReading: Rin says she can no longer revive someone near death and he himself dealt with the displaced innards.
findings.explanation: Rin can no longer resuscitate, and his self-repair becomes her inability question. (alternate branch).

findings.highlight: You might have survived this time, but you might not live to tell the tale next time you get hurt like last night. It's probably best you just ditch the notion that any small wounds will heal on their own."
findings.evidenceJa: 今回は助かったからいいけど、次にあんな傷を負ったらまず助からない筈だから。多少の傷なら治る、なんていう甘い考えは捨てた方がいいでしょうね」
findings.governingReading: She expects he would almost certainly fail to survive another such wound and warns against relying on healing.
findings.explanation: Likely not surviving the next comparable wound becomes merely might not survive. (alternate branch).

findings.highlight: The Servants have wishes of their own. That's why they respond to summons that would otherwise be, at best, unreasonable."
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントたちにもね、それぞれ何らかの欲望があるのよ。だからこそ彼等は本来有り得ない召喚に応じている」
findings.governingReading: Their wishes make them respond to an otherwise impossible summoning.
findings.explanation: Normally impossible summoning becomes unreasonable summoning. (alternate branch).

findings.highlight: "What, you have some hang-up with killing? You've got some nerve calling yourself a mage, with morals like that."
findings.evidenceJa: 「なに、人殺しだっていうの？　魔術師のクセにまだそんな正義感振り回してるわけ、貴方？」
findings.governingReading: Rin asks whether he calls this killing humans, then challenges continuing to brandish justice despite being a mage.
findings.explanation: Calling this murder and persisting in justice becomes a killing hang-up and illegitimate mage claim. (alternate branch).

findings.highlight: But as soon as Servants materialize, they can interact with the physical world. You could say they're the ultimate weapons.
findings.evidenceJa: にも関わらず実体を持つかのように現世に干渉できるという時点で、サーヴァントは最強の兵器と言えるだろう。
findings.governingReading: Despite being unseen spirit bodies, they can interfere with this world as if having physical bodies.
findings.explanation: Invisible spirits affecting the world as if physical acquire materialization as a condition. (alternate branch).

findings.highlight: When people die to an invisible killer, those deaths will just be treated as accidents or natural causes.
findings.evidenceJa: 姿のない殺戮者に襲われた人間の死は、事故死か自殺としか扱われまい。
findings.governingReading: Invisible-killer deaths would be treated as accidents or suicide.

findings.highlight: "Correct. To be fair, the magical energy supply from Masters chosen by the Holy Grail should be enough in most cases.
findings.evidenceJa: 「ご名答。まあ魔力の補充なんて、聖杯に補助されたマスターからの提供だけで、大抵は事足りる。
findings.governingReading: The Grail supports the supplying Masters so their mana usually suffices.
findings.explanation: Grail-assisted Masters become Grail-chosen Masters. (alternate branch).

findings.highlight: For one thing, the Association won't just turn a blind eye to someone going around murdering people, but more importantly, the other Masters will be able to figure out the Servant's abilities and identity based on the victims' cause of death. That, and they'll work out the other Master's identity too.
findings.evidenceJa: それにあからさまに殺人を犯せば協会が黙ってないし、なによりその死因からサーヴァントの能力と正体が、他のマスターたちにバレかねない。もちろんマスター自身の正体もね。
findings.governingReading: Victim death causes could reveal Servant identity/abilities and the Master’s identity.
findings.explanation: Identity exposure risk becomes a firm prediction of identification. (alternate branch).

findings.highlight: Conversely, if the other Masters know who you are, you're just asking to be ambushed.
findings.evidenceJa: 逆に誰がマスターかを知っていれば、確実に奇襲ができる。
findings.governingReading: If you know who is a Master, you can reliably make a surprise attack.
findings.explanation: Your knowing the others enables your ambush becomes their knowing you enables their ambush. (alternate branch).

findings.highlight: For a fleeting second, Tohsaka looks repulsed.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂のヤツ、一瞬呆れたように見えたけど……？
findings.governingReading: For a moment she appears 呆れた at his chosen order of discussion.

findings.highlight: "I should have mentioned this sooner, but Servants are spirits. Their forms are complete, static, so they do not grow."
findings.evidenceJa: 「一つ言い忘れていたけど、サーヴァントっていうのは霊なの。彼等はもう完成したものだから、今以上の成長はない。
findings.governingReading: 27’s explanation continues through its final entry, while46’s explanatory introduction ends before narration.
findings.explanation: One continuing Rin speech closes early; another fails to close.
